configuration.stored_config: unchanged pilot configuration, exported before and after

equipment: Foxeer F405 V2 on USB only

commands.command: ferro-configurator flash --board foxeer-f405-v2 --yes <candidate> (bench image running, flight log open)

observations: Disarmed throughout; battery reading 0.0 V, so ESCs were unpowered.
reboot and reboot dfu were both refused with 'ERR flight log still being written' by the bench_blackbox image; flash --yes then exited 5 and the board kept running FerroWasp.
The F405 ROM bootloader reported dfuERROR / 'firmware is corrupt' as its first status after both command entry and BOOT-button entry; dfu-util cleared it each time.
Configuration exports before and after flashing are byte-identical.
The bench_blackbox image appended flight 14 (10970880 bytes) to the board's log; flights 1-13 were downloaded beforehand.
limitations: Step 6 ran on the same commit before this procedure was written; steps 1-5 ran after it was committed.
Propeller state is as stated in the session plan the user approved, not separately confirmed during the run.
Linux host only; the Windows package's bundled dfu-util and WinUSB path were not exercised.
The GUI has no flash or reboot controls yet.
